full_judgment:
Syed Mahmud Hossain J.: This civil petition for leave to appeal is directed against the judgment and order dated 02.08.2009 passed by a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No.  3429 of 1992 discharging the Rule and affirming the judgment and decree dated 22.10.1992 passed by the learned Additional District Judge First Court, Sylhet in Title Appeal No. 124 Of 1984 affirming the judgment and decree dated 22.02.1984 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, Second Court, Sylhet in Title Suit No. 263 of 1977 decreeing the suit. 

 4. The learned Subordinate Judge, Second Court, Sylhet, by his judgment and decree dated 22.02.1984 decreed the suit. 

 5. Against the judgment and decree of the learned Subordinate Judge, defendant Nos. 4 to 6 preferred Title Appeal No. 124 of 1984 before the learned District Judge, Sylhet. On transfer, the appeal was heard by the learned Additional District Judge, First Court, Sylhet who by his judgment and decree dated 22.10.1992 affirmed the judgment and decree passed by the learned Subordinate Judge. 

 6. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the judgment and decree dated 22.10.1992 passed by the appellate Court, contesting defendants filed a revisional application before the High Court Division and obtained a Rule being Civil Revision No. 3429 of 1992. The learned Single Judge of the High Court Division by his judgment and order dated 02.08.2009 discharged the Rule without any order as to costs.
